messages:
cami: Heads up — noticed several SCIM provisioning jobs against corp-idp failing to attach RBAC roles. API returns 202 then users land with no roles. Logs show intermittent KMS decrypt errors. Anyone triaging?

ops-bot: alert: scim-provisioner: 35 failures in last 10m for corp-idp (rule=scim-role-attach)

julia: looking. Do we have repro steps? Any affected tenant IDs?

cami: tenant=acme-inc, sample user alice@acme.com. Root logs (from provisioning-worker) —
```
2026-03-22T15:03:41Z ERROR scim: role-attach failed user=alice@acme.com err="kms: decrypt failed: context mismatch"
2026-03-22T15:03:44Z INFO scim: queued retry in 30s
```

mike: That context mismatch smells like the KMS envelope/context key changed during a rotation. Are we passing the right encryption context? Recently rolled key alias? @sana ?

sana: We rolled alias alias/redwood-scim/2026-03 on 2026-03-21 22:00 UTC. Rolls should be safe. I'll check KMS audit trail. Can you paste provisioning payload headers (x-kms-context)?

cami: payload header present: `x-kms-context: tenant=acme-inc;provisioner=scim-v2;role=prod-admin` — looks right. But I also see intermittent 403 from idp when role attach invoked.

julia: Maybe the request routing hit a stale node with old KMS cache. We have a caching layer in scim-provisioner service. @security-oncall any SRE hints for cache invalidation after keyrotate?

security-oncall: We implemented soft-cache flush on rotate, but there was a bug where the cache key used `alias` not `alias+version`. If alias reused, old entries persisted. Patch rolled at 03:30 UTC — after your failures. Can you check if failures >03:30?

cami: failures peak around 15:03 UTC, so yes pre-patch. Post-patch retries succeeded for many but 12 users still failed and need manual fix.

mike: For manual fix: trigger scim re-provision for affected users; workaround: re-encrypt ext_id with current KMS version and re-run role attach. I'll add runbook steps.

julia: I'll open a follow-up PR to include key version in cache key and add a e2e test that simulates alias swap. Also adding an audit alert when scim role attach hits KMS decrypt error >5/min.

cami: thanks. Patching playbook + list of affected users attached. :thumbsup: 

sana: KMS audit shows ReEncrypt operations during rotation window; no unauthorized access. Will coordinate with compliance to note this in the rotation log.
